reason: Natural arrival availability excluded almost all unchosen candidates and almost all visual dispersion variation.
state_sampling: Exactly all eligible historical states in the existing D1 collections; no new policy rollouts or oracle-dependent state filtering.
candidate_sampling: Exactly replay_diagnostics.chosen_candidates(state,seed=0), chosen non-STOP plus one hash-selected other legal candidate, determined before future availability.
branch_execution: Rebuild the prefix discovered graph in original update order; verify distances, step/hop features and visited set; execute the legal route using the same final predecessor pointId heading/elevation as DUET. Independent simulator only.
parity_gate: Verify chosen next-step natural arrivals match branch heading and full panorama features, then verify original navigation logits and input SHA remain identical.
privileged_observation: Target panorama encoding includes new candidate nav_types and angles. It is a full offline observation, not pure visual completion. Only the target graph feature is replaced for interventions.
shuffle_missing_policy: Retain row in primary cohort; matched-control comparisons use the same available subset. Report geometry mismatch.
fitting: Only train_fit; fixed ridge/logistic alpha=1, original P3 raw arrival-delta target, existing 5-fold by training houses; no new hyperparameter search.
primary_diagnostics: P0+P1 versus P0 on teacher-optimal log loss
true/normmatched versus shuffled on identical subsets
uncertainty: Paired whole-house bootstrap seed0,1000 replicates; teacher/execution classification equivalence is not independent evidence.
training_promotion: Require positive incremental observable signal and a meaningful auxiliary observation-specific signal beyond matched controls before main-method training. If evidence remains insufficient after this expansion, stop this proposed arrival-margin supervision rather than keep changing probes.

controls_semantics.arrival: endpoint panorama at last legal route edge pointId heading/elevation
controls_semantics.arrival_headingmatched: same endpoint re-encoded at historical state heading/elevation
controls_semantics.shuffled_arrival: geometry-selected alternative candidate at its own legal route arrival heading
controls_semantics.shuffled_normmatched: same donor scaled to original target proxy norm
controls_semantics.shuffled_headingmatched: geometry-selected alternative candidate re-encoded at historical state heading/elevation

smoke_validation.role: implementation acceptance only; these episode IDs are a subset of D1 and smoke rows are excluded from statistical analysis
